source: FEATURE-20261119-jove-drifter-archaeology-sub3 (D14862, D14134). The final reward of a Living New Eden archaeology trail (341600-341619, 341606-341619 reserved). 341600 Jovian Archive Analyzer = clone of Data Analyzer II 30834, 341602 Drifter Lattice Analyzer = clone of Relic Analyzer II 30832 (group of the source, no group change). SDE 3396210 typeDogma: virusStrength (attribute 1910) 30834 = 30, best vanilla data analyzer 3581 = 40 -> 30 + floor((40 - 30) / 2) = 35; 30832 = 30, best vanilla relic analyzer 85750 = 35 -> 30 + floor((35 - 30) / 2) = 32 (dev item 33375 and the combined analyzers excluded); virusCoherence 1909 = 60 and virusElementSlots 1911 = 3 as the T2. 341601 / 341603 blueprints = clones of 30835 / 30833 (category 9; manufacturing = the recipe of the source with the new product, copying 3744 s, no research, no invention), max 3 runs per copy. 341604 Jovian Archive Core / 341605 Drifter Lattice Core = trophies, clones of Manufacturing Tools 16686 (group 314, category 17), no blueprint. All sources have a typeDogma record (D700). iconID 21618 = res:/UI/Texture/Icons/Modules/multiUseAnalyzer_64.png, 21785 = res:/UI/Texture/Icons/Inventory/relicVault.png, 27336 = res:/UI/Texture/Icons/Inventory/Drifter_Data_64.png (SDE icons). No market group, not in the shop (blueprints shop.listed false): the archaeology trail puts the blueprint copy (3 runs) and the trophy into its last archive (archaeology.finalRewardJoveCsv / finalRewardDrifterCsv). Client: re-run ApplyClientData.

overrides.name: Jovian Archive Analyzer
overrides.description: A data analyzer tuned on the decoded archives of a lost Jovian trail. Recovered from the last archive at the end of a Living New Eden archaeology trail. Virus strength above the Tech II analyzer.

overrides.description: Blueprint of the Jovian Archive Analyzer, the recipe of the Data Analyzer II Blueprint. Recovered from the last archive at the end of a Living New Eden archaeology trail. Maximum 3 runs per copy.
